body:
The fast H3 VAE decoder is the non-causal 24-layer decoder of StreamRender-H3, distilled from the released H3 VAE; it decodes the 2560×1440 clip in 1.6 s instead of 15 s. Latent upscale + refine alone go from 73.11 s to 20.46 s (3.57×).

## Ficha rápida

- Efficient-Large-Model/Open-H3-Regenerate-2K
- parámetros desconocidos
- licencia other
- 149 likes en Hugging Face

## Descripción original

An open replacement for the closed H3-Regenerate-2K API: a three-step MiniMax-H3 refinement pass that regenerates a 768P H3 draft (1344×768, 121 frames) at 2560×1440.

One 5 s clip, 768P latent → 2560×1440 video: latent upscale + 3-step refine + VAE decode, warm, median of 3 runs:

The fast H3 VAE decoder is the non-causal 24-layer decoder of StreamRender-H3, distilled from the released H3 VAE; it decodes the 2560×1440 clip in 1.6 s instead of 15 s. Latent upscale + refine alone go from 73.11 s to 20.46 s (3.57×).

basemodel/ mirrors MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3 @ 6818f6c without changes (the native FL2VA/, Ref2VA/ and transformerref/ folders are left out). download.py in the code folder fetches everything here plus the optional HyperFlow 8-step adapter and Sharp's 1025×8 adalnttable (a base-derived tensor, read by byte range from Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3).
